tools.name: marmin_list_business_profiles
tools.description: List the Marmin business profiles (legal entities) of this organization, with TRN, TIN, Peppol endpoint and onboarding status. Use profile_id from the result to know which entity a document belongs to. Read-only. Limit: 30 requests/minute.

tools.name: marmin_get_business_profile
tools.description: Get one business profile by its profile_id (for example MBP-00001): legal name, TRN, trade license, Peppol endpoint, address and onboarding status. Read-only.

tools.name: marmin_list_documents
tools.description: List tax invoices, credit notes or proforma invoices of one kind, newest first as Marmin returns them. Each item has the number, dates, type code (380 invoice, 381 credit note, 389 self-billed, 261 self-billed credit note), parties, amounts and currency. Filter by number, party name, VAT number, sta

tools.name: marmin_list_document_uuids
tools.description: List the ids (UUIDs) of all documents of one kind that were created on one day. Use it to find new documents day by day, then read each with marmin_get_document. Read-only.

tools.name: marmin_get_document
tools.description: Get one invoice, credit note or proforma invoice by id: parties, lines, tax breakdown, totals (also in AED) and meta_info.peppol_status (overall_status PENDING, APPROVED, REJECTED or VALIDATION_FAILED, with validation_results). Read-only.

tools.name: marmin_get_document_xml
tools.description: Get the UAE e-invoicing XML (UBL 2.1, PINT AE) of an invoice or credit note. Long XML is cut by the server's result size limit. Read-only.

tools.name: marmin_get_peppol_status
tools.description: Get the current Peppol transmission snapshot of an invoice or credit note: the billing leg (toC3, to the buyer's access point) and the tax-reporting leg (toC5, to the FTA), each with status and transmission errors, plus validation results. The XML copies are left out. Needs Phase 2 in the Marmin sub

tools.name: marmin_get_peppol_status_log
tools.description: Get the time-ordered Peppol events of a sales invoice, sales credit note or purchase credit note (DOCUMENT_CREATED, DOCUMENT_SUBMITTED, VALIDATION_SUCCESS and so on) with a message each. Use it to see why a document was rejected. The XML copies are left out. Read-only.

tools.name: marmin_get_register_entry
tools.description: Get one document register entry (the sales or purchase register of a business profile) by its id, including the linked document_id for e-invoices. Read-only.

tools.name: marmin_get_codelist
tools.description: Get a Marmin code list: valid values for invoice fields, for example tax-categories, unit-of-measure-codes, uae-subdivisions (emirate codes), currencies, credit-note-reason-codes, payment-means-modes, tax-exemption-reason-codes. Read-only.
